column1: # Blackwell lineup (sm_100/103/110/120/121) -- per-op scheduling divergences.
# Our own differential-analysis result (NOT a binary byte table): isolated probes
# compiled with this exact ptxas (CUDA 13.0.88) and disassembled (nvdisasm 13.1),
# reading the SASS control word (decoded/sass-tools/sass_ctrl_decode.py).  Regenerate
# with measure_blackwell_deltas.py.
# WHY THE METRIC CHANGED (corrects a prior version of this file):
#   A single "stall cycles per op" number is NOT a sound per-arch fact.  The usched
#   stall field is the gap to the NEXT issued instruction, which the scheduler fills
#   with reordered independent work; it changes with register pressure and neighbours.
#   Re-measuring with isolated single-producer/single-consumer probes -- and re-checking
#   every candidate divergence across 2-4 operand/consumer/pressure variants -- shows
#   the only reorder-INVARIANT signals are (a) coupled-vs-decoupled (does the producer
#   set a write scoreboard?) and (b) the dependent-chain issue gap.  Several deltas in
#   the prior file (POPC/I2FP/F2I numbers, and the LOP3 / general-MUFU divergences) did
#   not survive that re-check and are corrected to "identical" / "artifact" below.
# All five arches share the lat10x latency-descriptor family (.rodata 0x226C880) and
# the sm_103 dependency-rule + scoreboard tables EXCEPT sm_100, which installs its own
# dep-rule + scoreboard set (installer sub_ABF590: enum 0x4000=sm_100, 0x4001=sm_103;
# sm_110/120/121 resolve to the 0x4001 sm_103 set).  The divergences below are the
# residual per-arch behaviour observed in emitted SASS on top of those tables.
# Notation:  c = coupled (fixed pipeline latency, no scoreboard);
#            D = decoupled (variable latency, producer sets a write scoreboard);
#            the number is the producer's usched value in the isolated probe.
# ROBUST divergences (survive every probe variant) ----------------------------------
